initial_decision.brief_rationale: Promotion probability is 0.8 in both observed mentoring groups, but this descriptive equality does not identify the causal effect. Request archived design record R135-2 to assess causal identification.

final_decision.brief_rationale: Both observed promotion risks are 0.8, giving a descriptive difference of zero. The design record supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying counterfactual risks. The average causal risk difference is therefore not uniquely identified.
